evals.name: min-touch-target
evals.prompt: What is the minimum recommended touch-target size for an interactive control on iOS, and on Android? Give the numbers and units.
evals.expected_output: iOS: 44 x 44 pt (HIG; absolute floor 28x28). Android/Material: 48 x 48 dp. Both numbers with correct units. (Control item — baseline models usually know this.)

evals.name: no-in-app-appearance-toggle
evals.prompt: A designer wants to add a Light/Dark/System appearance picker inside our iOS app's settings. Is that the right call per Apple's guidance?
evals.expected_output: No — apps should respect the systemwide appearance setting and NOT ship an app-specific dark-mode toggle (Dark Mode HIG). Supplying a 'System' default that follows the OS is fine; a full in-app override toggle is discouraged.
evals.truth: no — respect system appearance, don't add app toggle

evals.name: color-alone
evals.prompt: We signal form-field errors by turning the field's border red. Accessibility concern?
evals.expected_output: Yes — must not convey state/meaning by COLOR ALONE (HIG Accessibility; fails for color-blind/low-vision users and WCAG). Pair the color with an icon and/or text label. Also ensure contrast 4.5:1.
evals.truth: yes — color alone insufficient, add icon/text
